subject: SIG kickoff: prefill + a few ops clarifications
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@fintegral.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2026 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: SIG kickoff: prefill + a few ops clarifications

Hi Emily — great to meet earlier today. Thanks for walking us through Fintegral's high-level architecture; captured a few follow-ups below so we can start the SIG/CAIQ prefill and map evidence owners.

Quick recap / asks:
- You're happy to proceed with the SIG-lite prefill as the starting point — thank you.
- Please confirm the primary contact for evidence uploads (security@fintegral.com listed on the call).
- Two clarifying items that will change routing/evidence: (1) whether Fintegral uses customer-managed KMS for production keys, and (2) whether there are any EU data residency requirements for this project.

Next steps from our side: attaching a prefill workbook (FINTEGRAL_SIG_PREFILL_v1.xlsx) with the sections we typically complete first (org profile, hosting, data flows). We'll prefill the hosting and SOC 2 sections where we already have canonical answers, and then flag rows that need Fintegral confirmation.

Can you please:
1) Confirm the evidence owner email (reply to this thread).
2) Flag any questions below that need expansion before we start the prefill.

Clarifying questions (short):
- SOC 2: Do you have a current SOC 2 Type II report? If yes, approximate date and whether it can be shared under NDA.
- KMS: Are production encryption keys managed by Fintegral in your KMS (customer-managed) or by the cloud provider?
- Data residency: Will any regulated EU data be processed/stored by Redwood for this engagement?

I'll get Soojin (security lead) and Neha (customer engineer) to start the prefill once we have the evidence owner and answers above.

Attachments: FINTEGRAL_SIG_PREFILL_v1.xlsx (prefill workbook), Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2026.pdf (summary page for quick review)

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0143

--
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference platform
From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@fintegral.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: security@fintegral.com
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2026 09:10:00 -0500
Subject: Re: SIG kickoff: prefill + a few ops clarifications

Thanks Marcus — quick answers from our side and a couple of questions back:

Answers:
- Evidence owner: Please route uploads to security@fintegral.com (that inbox is monitored by our InfoSec ops team).
- SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type II report (issued Aug 2026). We can share an excerpt under the mutual NDA; full report requires an access agreement.
- KMS: Production keys are on AWS KMS and managed by us (customer-managed).
- Data residency: We process customer data in the us-west-2 region only; no EU residency requirements for this pilot.

Follow-up clarifications:
1) For the prefill workbook: can Redwood mark answers as "confirmed by vendor" vs "redwood-provided"? That will help expedite our internal reviewer.
2) We have a small ops nuance: our CI/CD builds push some debug logs to an S3 bucket for 7 days before rotation. Will that change any of the evidence asks you typically surface?

Happy to have security@fintegral.com upload the SOC excerpt and any relevant KMS architecture diagrams. Estimated timeline from our side: SOC excerpt and KMS diagram by end of day Thursday (Nov 4).

Emily Carter
Head of InfoSec, Fintegral Inc
emily.carter@fintegral.com | +1 (617) 555-0890
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@fintegral.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, security@fintegral.com
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG kickoff: prefill + a few ops clarifications

Thanks Emily — this is perfect, and exactly the level of detail we needed. A few quick notes and how we'll proceed:

1) Prefill annotations: yes — we'll mark each answered row with one of three states: "redwood-provided", "vendor-confirmed", or "needs-evidence". That should make your reviewer work a lot easier.

2) CI/CD debug logs: short answer — likely flagged as low-sensitivity operational logs. For the SIG prefill we'll document the retention (7 days) and bucket controls (access IAM role + encryption). We'll mark the row "needs-evidence" and list the expected artifacts: S3 bucket ACL screenshot, retention policy, and proof of encryption (KMS key id).

3) Timeline & next steps:
- We will prefill the workbook sections we own and flag ~15 rows for Fintegral confirmation. Expect the prefilled workbook back to you by end of day Wednesday (Nov 3) in Drive link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3cSIG-prefill-template
- Please upload SOC excerpt and KMS diagram to security@fintegral.com by Nov 4 as noted. Once we receive those, Soojin will review and follow up with any specific evidence gaps or a short virtual walk-through (15–20 min).

4) Administrative: if you prefer a shared folder for evidence instead of email attachments, we can create a secure upload link (let me know).

I'll attach the prefilled workbook (v1) in the next email. Thanks again — talk soon.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0143

--
